cuisines.name: Moroccan Cuisine
cuisines.description: Moroccan cuisine is a vibrant tapestry of Berber, Arab, Andalusian, and Mediterranean influences, renowned for its bold use of spices like ras el hanout, saffron, and cumin. Slow-cooked tagines, fragrant couscous, and flaky pastilla define a culinary tradition that is as ceremonious as it is delicious.

cuisines.description: Italian cuisine is celebrated worldwide for its simplicity, quality ingredients, and deep regional diversity—from the rich ragùs of Bologna to the seafood-laden tables of Sicily. cuisines.name: French Cuisine
cuisines.description: French cuisine is the cornerstone of Western culinary tradition, codified by generations of chefs who elevated cooking to a fine art. recipes.name: Longjing Tea

cuisines.name: Indonesian Cuisine
cuisines.description: Indonesian cuisine reflects the extraordinary diversity of an archipelago of over 17,000 islands, weaving together Malay, Chinese, Dutch, Indian, and Arab influences into a bold, spice-forward culinary tradition. From the coconut-milk-braised rendang of West Sumatra to the layered rice ceremonial feasts of Bali, it is a cuisine that speaks through sambal, fermented shrimp paste, and the generous hand of the mortar and pestle.

recipes.name: Nasi Goreng
recipes.description: Indonesian fried rice stir-fried with kecap manis, shrimp paste, and chilies, crowned with a fried egg and prawn crackers.

recipes.name: Rendang
recipes.description: Beef slow-cooked for hours in coconut milk and a rich rempah spice paste until the sauce caramelizes dry onto the meat.

recipes.name: Sate Ayam
recipes.description: Chicken skewers marinated in sweet soy and turmeric, grilled over charcoal and served with a peanut sauce and lontong.

recipes.name: Gado-Gado
recipes.description: Blanched vegetables, tofu, and hard-boiled egg dressed in a rich peanut and kecap manis sauce with prawn crackers.

recipes.name: Opor Ayam
recipes.description: Chicken gently simmered in a lemongrass and galangal-spiced coconut milk broth until tender and aromatic.

recipes.name: Mie Goreng
recipes.description: Indonesian fried egg noodles tossed with chicken, prawns, kecap manis, and sambal in a smoky wok.

recipes.name: Ayam Betutu
recipes.description: A Balinese whole chicken rubbed in a complex spice paste of galangal, candlenuts, and chilies and slow-roasted in banana leaf.

recipes.name: Bebek Goreng
recipes.description: Spice-marinated whole duck slow-cooked until tender then deep-fried until the skin shatters, a Javanese delicacy.

recipes.name: Nasi Padang

recipes.name: Soto Ayam

recipes.name: Rawon

recipes.name: Soto Betawi

recipes.name: Sop Buntut

recipes.name: Sayur Lodeh

recipes.name: Garang Asem

recipes.name: Sup Iga

recipes.name: Cap Cay

recipes.name: Soto Madura

recipes.name: Martabak

recipes.name: Siomay

recipes.name: Tahu Tek

recipes.name: Es Campur

recipes.name: Kue Lumpur

recipes.name: Batagor
